'''Weibo Gaming''' is a Chinese team owned by '''Sina Corporation'''. They are currently known as '''Weibo''' '''Gaming TapTap''' for sponsorship reasons. 

== History ==

== Trivia ==
* WBG's 2023 Spring Roster is the 2nd All Pro Team of [[LPL 2022 Spring#Season Awards|2022 Spring]].
